notes: This is a low-priority legacy descriptor; a more specific future descriptor for this exact model can override it with a higher priority.
The two product IDs were inherited from a combined G5/G7 descriptor and are believed to cover G5's hardware revisions, but have not been independently re-verified against real devices.
DPI minimum corrected 200 -> 400: libratbag's logitech-g5.device and logitech-g5-2007.device both declare DpiList=400;800;1600;2000 for 0xC041/0xC049 respectively, with no 200 entry in either file.

Split 0xC049 out into legacy-g5-v2.json: this file now covers only the original 2005 G5 (0xC041). Press coverage (Techgage, APH Networks) states the original had a single thumb button and two separate DPI +/- buttons, not the Back/Forward/'DPI control' layout previously listed here -- corrected. Evidence is community/press-tier (manufacturerSpec-adjacent, quoting official box/press text), not an official Logitech spec page, since none could be found still live for this model.
